en.title: 'Cite Your Sources' in a Prompt Isn't Grounding: Use Claude's Citations Feature
en.subtitle: A citation Claude writes because you asked is just more text. The Citations feature returns exact, verifiable locations in your documents.

ar-EG.title: إنك تكتب «اذكر المصادر» في الـ prompt مش grounding: استخدم الـ Citations في Claude
ar-EG.subtitle: الـ citation اللي Claude بيكتبها عشان انت طلبتها مجرد نص زيادة. أما الـ Citations feature فبترجّعلك أماكن مضبوطة في مستنداتك تقدر تتأكد منها.

stubs.python:
import sys
import types

NS = types.SimpleNamespace
HANDBOOK = ("4.1 Annual bonus. The annual bonus is paid to employees only. "
            "4.2 Parental leave. Employees get 16 weeks of paid parental leave.")
QUESTION = "I'm a contractor with 12 months of service. Am I eligible for the annual bonus?"


def _cite(text, start):
    return NS(type="char_location", cited_text=text, document_index=0,
              document_title="Employee Handbook 2026",
              start_char_index=start, end_char_index=start + len(text))


def _create(*, model, max_tokens, messages, **kwargs):
    content = messages[-1]["content"]
    docs = [b for b in content if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "document"]
    if not docs:
        text = ("Contractors with 12 months of service are eligible "
                "[Handbook §4.2].")
        return NS(content=[NS(type="text", text=text, citations=None)],
                  stop_reason="end_turn")
    assert all(d.get("citations", {}).get("enabled") for d in docs)
    return NS(content=[
        NS(type="text", text="No. ", citations=None),
        NS(type="text", text="The annual bonus is paid to employees only.",
           citations=[_cite("The annual bonus is paid to employees only. ", 18)]),
        NS(type="text", text=" Contracts may differ, so check yours.", citations=None),
    ], stop_reason="end_turn")


class _Anthropic:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.messages = NS(create=_create)


sys.modules["anthropic"] = NS(Anthropic=_Anthropic)
